version.summary: Clear automatic-save status, consistent Translate controls, and document tools before translation.
notes: Completed translations show their automatically saved filename and explain when another export is optional.
The blue Translate button appears immediately after Optimize when a source document is first opened.
Export an untranslated PDF as Word (.docx), or Word as PDF. Conversion is text-only; original-format export keeps images, stamps, watermarks, tables and layout.
Word documents can be stamped and watermarked before translation; Falcon previews the embedded marks in their page positions.
Review edits are saved in Falcon; the editor explains that Export writes those edits into a document.
